title: Enterprise AI/HPC Partner & Colocation Data Center Site Qualification, Turn-Up & Acceptance Readiness Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Legacy Air-Cooled Colo (<20kW/Rack) + Ping/SSH-Only Handover (Anti-Pattern)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: Thermal throttling, dirty fiber optics (61% busbw) & 34.5% Month-1 job aborts

tiers.name: Tier 2: Retrofitted Rear-Door Heat Exchanger (RDHx <=40kW) + Single-Node DCGM Smoke Test
tiers.verdict: Single-node smoke tests miss cross-rack cabling swaps, dirty MPO-16 ferrules & CDU loops

tiers.name: Tier 3: Cold-Plate DLC Colo (No CDU-to-Pod Fault-Domain Alignment or 48h Thermal Soak)
tiers.verdict: Single CDU maintenance drains 4 separate training slices; early DOA optics escape 2h test

tiers.name: Tier 4: 8-Stage Gate + 120kW DLC/CDU Pod Alignment + 48h Soak (>=90% busbw / ICI) + 4-Tier Telemetry
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 9.5-day turn-up, 0.6% Month-1 abort rate, 94.8% busbw/ICI & -89.7% TCO
